# High mode sky

Active photographic cloud source: **Kloofendal 38d Partly Cloudy (Pure Sky)**.
Greg Zaal (original photography), Jarod Guest (sky edits), Poly Haven. CC0 1.0.
https://polyhaven.com/a/kloofendal_38d_partly_cloudy_puresky
https://polyhaven.com/license

`kloofendal-clouds-2k.hdr` is the original 2048 × 1024 RGBE file, downloaded
27 September 2026. MD5: `38ee83ed18b97311af058e41056999ea`.
Source: https://dl.polyhaven.org/file/ph-assets/HDRIs/hdr/2k/kloofendal_38d_partly_cloudy_puresky_2k.hdr
The renderer rotates the radiance around the horizon, applies preset exposure
and tint, and combines it with a shared key light and moving weather. The
photograph is sky-only and does not claim to depict Bhitarkanika.

Active Golden-hour source: Qwantani Sunset (Pure Sky), Greg Zaal (photography), Jarod Guest (processing), Poly Haven. CC0 1.0. 2K HDR retained unmodified.
